scripts.build:wasm: bun run build:wasm:collection && bun run build:wasm:dioxus
scripts.build:wasm:collection: cd examples/collection-web && wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir ../../web/public/collection-example --out-name collection-example
scripts.build:wasm:dioxus: cd examples/collection-dioxus && wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir ../../web/public/dioxus-example --out-name dioxus-example
